pkgmetadata.longdescription: vkd3d is Wine's implementation of Direct3D 12 on top of Vulkan, built as native libraries: libvkd3d (the D3D12 API), libvkd3d-shader (shader translation and the HLSL compiler) and libvkd3d-utils. Not to be confused with vkd3d-proton.

use.flag: Colour the output of vkd3d-compiler and vkd3d-dxbc with sys-libs/ncurses
Disassemble and validate SPIR-V output with dev-util/spirv-tools
